actions.text: Melee 9 to hit, reach 5 feet. 12 ([[d:2d6 + 5]]) Slashing damage plus 7 ([[d:2d6]]) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.text: Ranged 9 to hit, range 120 feet. 13 ([[d:3d8]]) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [[c:Prone]] condition.

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.text: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder [Area of Effect] centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. str saving throw DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). While in the whirlwind, the target has the [[c:Restrained]] condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the [[c:Restrained]] target takes 21 ([[d:6d6]]) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Heated Blade
actions.text: Melee 10 to hit, reach 5 ft. 13 ([[d:2d6 + 6]]) Slashing damage plus 13 ([[d:2d12]]) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.text: Ranged 8 to hit, range 120 ft. 24 ([[d:7d6]]) Fire damage.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

marid.name: Marid
marid.speed: walk 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 90 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The marid makes three Aquatic Lash attacks.

actions.name: Aquatic Lash
actions.text: Melee 10 to hit, reach 15 ft. 15 ([[d:2d8 + 6]]) Slashing damage plus 9 ([[d:2d8]]) Cold damage.

actions.name: Water Jet
actions.text: dex saving throw DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line [Area of Effect]. 31 ([[d:9d6]]) Cold damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the marid and has the [[c:Prone]] condition. Half damage only.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The marid can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the marid dies outside the Elemental Plane of Water, its body dissolves into brine, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Water.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The marid has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the marid knows it, the marid can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the marid can understand. If the marid casts the spell for the creature, the marid suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the marid has cast it three times, the marid can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.text: Melee 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. 7 ([[d:2d6]]) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Points maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 ([[d:1d10]]) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

vestige companion.name: Vestige Companion
vestige companion.hpText: 4 + four times your Warlock level (the vestige has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Warlock level)

actions.name: Vestige's Strike
actions.text: Melee,r} Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. [[d:1d6 + 3]] plus your Charisma modifier Fire (Fiend), Necrotic (Undead), or Radiant (Celestial) damage.

actions.name: Divine Power (1/Day)
actions.text: Your vestige manifests a remnant of its divine power in one of the following ways, based on its form:

traits.name: Pact Bond
traits.text: Add your Proficiency to any ability check or saving throw the vestige makes.
